name: discord-mcp
description: Run your Discord from Claude Code through your own bot: messages, moderation, roles, channels, forums, webhooks and events, plus a channel digest and a moderation sweep skill.

discord_token.title: Discord bot token
discord_token.description: Bot token from the Bot page of the Discord Developer Portal.

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: Comma-separated toolsets to expose, such as discovery,messages. Empty exposes every tool. An unknown name stops the server at startup.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Expose only the tools annotated readOnlyHint: true. Write tools are neither listed nor callable.

allowed_guilds.title: Allowed guilds
allowed_guilds.description: Comma-separated guild IDs the server may act on. Calls that target any other guild are rejected. Empty allows every guild.

message_content.title: Message Content intent
message_content.description: Request the Message Content privileged intent at connect time. Turn it off if the intent is disabled in the Developer Portal.

guild_members.title: Server Members intent
guild_members.description: Request the Server Members privileged intent at connect time. Turn it off if the intent is disabled in the Developer Portal.
